investigations.name: chemotactic-recruitment
investigations.title: Chemotactic recruitment
investigations.description: The reference vertical slice for the **Biological Claim Layer** — the proposal that a biological CLAIM (not an execution model) is the canonical source, with simulators as compile targets. Here a secreted chemotactic cue recruits responder cells, and recruitment requires BOTH the cue and a competent response. The claim, its mechanism, and its viva-cpm realization are authored as a backend-neutral bundle (investigations/chemotactic-recruitment/claim-bundle/). The claim is now carried by TWO realizations: the original PHENOMENOLOGICAL CPM realization (three studies, chemotaxis lambda a stand-in for the response) and a finer-grained RECEPTOR-LEVEL realization (two studies) in which the response is EMERGENT from a per-cell Hill receptor-occupancy model calibrated to a cited chemokine-receptor affinity. The semantic gap the first realization recorded is now closed by the second, not hidden. See the "Claim layer" figure and How-to-read below.
investigations.question:
Does a secreted chemotactic cue drive directional migration and recruitment of
responder cells into the source region, and does inhibiting the chemotactic
response reduce that recruitment?
investigations.hypothesis:
In a Cellular Potts world where source cells secrete a diffusible field and
responder cells chemotax up its gradient, responders will directionally migrate
toward and accumulate near the source region. Removing either the cue or the
response abolishes recruitment.

investigations.name: endosymbiosis
investigations.title: The Endosymbiotic Transition — enclosure mechanics (S3)
investigations.description: The physical-enclosure plane of the endosymbiosis phase diagram, computed on the real Rust CPM engine. One parameterized composite (protrusion_enclosure) runs the host/symbiont wrapping model; a 2-axis sweep over adhesion and symbiont surface tension classifies the enclosure regime at each point.
investigations.question: Can an archaeal-like deformable host physically surround and enclose a bacterial partner purely from differential adhesion, and under which mechanical conditions does wrapping reach a stable topology rather than a partial cup or a transient contact? This is the viva-cpm realization of gate G3 (Enclosure) of the viva-genesis eukaryogenesis campaign "The Endosymbiotic Transition" (campaign composite B — active membrane mechanics).
investigations.hypothesis: On a Cellular Potts lattice, the host engulfs the symbiont when host-symbiont adhesion beats the combined surface-tension cost (J_hs < J_sM - J_hM). Sweeping those mechanical energies traces a phase diagram with a sharp transition between no enclosure, partial wrapping, transient internalization, and stable enclosure — stable wrapping as an emergent outcome, not an imposed threshold.

investigations.name: glazier-graner-1993
investigations.title: Glazier & Graner 1993 — differential-adhesion cell rearrangement
investigations.description: A faithful, full-scale reproduction of every simulation example in Glazier & Graner 1993 using the viva-cpm Rust CPM engine, one study per parameter set, remaking all figures (Figs 2-5, 7-9, 12-28; Tables I-III).
investigations.question: Can a single extended-Potts (Cellular Potts) model with only differential surface energies and an area constraint reproduce the full range of differential-adhesion-driven cell-rearrangement phenomena reported by Glazier & Graner (Phys. Rev. E 47, 2128, 1993)?
investigations.hypothesis: Varying only the type-dependent adhesion energies J(tau,tau') and the area constraint reproduces checkerboard mixing, complete and partial cell sorting, engulfment, position reversal, dispersal, and cavity formation, with matching patterns and topological statistics.

investigations.name: influenza-sego2022
investigations.title: Influenza infection & immune response (Sego 2022 reproduction)
investigations.description: A ground-up native reproduction of a published cellularized multiscale infection model (Sego, Mochan, Ermentrout & Glazier 2022, J. Theor. Biol. 532:110918), used as a rigor exercise for viva-cpm's CPM engine: can it reach quantitative figure match against a real, independently published spatial immunology model, using the authors' own CompuCell3D source as ground truth rather than just the paper's prose? The investigation was built up in stages — first establishing the specification and acceptance targets, then validating individual mechanisms at reduced scale, and finally assembling the full model for a capstone reproduction — so that reproducibility accrued cumulatively and each stage was independently reviewable.
investigations.question:
Can viva-cpm's native Cellular Potts engine reproduce, to quantitative figure
match, the cellularized multiscale influenza-infection and immune-response
model of Sego et al. 2022 — built on CompuCell3D's ViralInfectionVTM — at
paper scale (Figs 3B, 5, 7)?
investigations.hypothesis:
A CPM composite that reproduces the paper's cell types (epithelial,
macrophage, NK, CD8+ T), diffusible fields (virus, type-I IFN, chemokine,
IL-10), per-cell resistance/state transitions, and coupling to the global
immune ODE compartment — parameterized from the CC3D source
(ViralInfectionVTM) as ground truth, cross-checked against the paper's own
tables — will land within the paper's reported acceptance bands for
infected/uninfected/dead epithelial counts and immune-cell trajectories
across the initial-viral-load and initial-infection-fraction scenario
sweeps.
